We'd need to run a mock server on port 8002 that mimics the API. Not provided though. But we could write one? That's beyond installation... but it says "Optional mock backend for local development". And api client base = http://localhost:8002/{tenant}.

So a mock could be a simple FastAPI/uvicorn app within the same container listening on 8002. But that's fabricating a backend not part of the repo.
